policy.lookup_key: packet ability_id plus semantic hit_event_id, with packet damage_source required only for source-disambiguated rules; omitted optional hit_event_id is zero
policy.ambiguous_keys: formula-equivalent standard candidates are retained together; conflicting candidates require an exact current-build static route for every candidate plus packet damage_source
policy.nonstandard_scripts: excluded until each DamageScript formula is independently proven
policy.coefficient_selection: one-value vectors are stage invariant; multi-value vectors use zero-based packet owner_stage and omitted owner_stage is zero
policy.fixed_parameter_selection: empty vectors contribute zero; populated vectors use one-based packet owner_level
policy.unresolved_events: canonical damage is always retained and never hidden
